body: 2026-09-24. gopkg.in/yaml.v3 with KnownFields(true) (unknown keys error), located by voltkit appdir (AGX_CONFIG_DIR / AGX_HOME override). Optional: zero-config discovery covers the common case. Why: voltkit ships no loader, the file is hand-edited and holds lists of profiles; strict parsing catches typos. A discovered profile whose name collides with a configured one is renamed <provider>-<name>.
title: AGX-004: optional strict YAML config at ~/.agx/config.yaml
